verdict.rationale: Steel is a browser-API platform (not itself an agent), so the axis applies, and its docs explicitly describe exposing a Steel browser as an MCP server/tool set ('Expose a Steel browser to any MCP client' and 'exposes a cloud browser as in-process MCP tools' for the Claude Agent SDK integration), letting external agents connect via MCP. Missing for 10: deeper standalone MCP-server setup docs/config reference, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond a single cookbook and integration mention.
